{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：自动记录所有执行模式（原生工具 / PTC run_code / 代码内嵌工具调用）的工具失败错因，去重、计数、确定性排序后沉淀进 skill 的机器维护实录区段——让 Agent 越用越少错。","id":"gh:1333463381","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-fail-logger","slug":"Areium/dsh-fail-logger","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","fail-logger","skill"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：自动记录所有执行模式（原生工具 / PTC run_code / 代码内嵌工具调用）的工具失败错因，去重、计数、确定性排序后沉淀进 skill 的机器维"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"护实录区段——让 Agent 越用越少错。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"中文 | English"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# dsh-fail-logger"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"[](https://github.com/Areium/dsh-fail-logger/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin"},{"id":"p4s2","text":".com/) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-fail-logger)"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"An all-mode tool failure recorder for DeepSeek Harness: whether the agent runs in **native mode** or"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" **PTC (Code Mode)**, any tool failure is automatically written into the machine-maintained section "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"of a skill — normalized-dedup, counted, deterministically ranked, TTL-pruned, and redacted — so the "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"next session's model sees the most common failure causes when it loads the skill. **Fail less over t"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"ession's model sees the most common failure causes when it loads the skill. **Fail less over time.**"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Coverage matrix & trigger conditions"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Execution mode | Failure source | Recorded as (kind / message) |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Native tools (read/grep/write and third-party plugin tools…) | `tool/call` + `tool/result` (tool-r"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"esult block isError=true) | `tool` / `[read] ENOENT: no such file …` |
| PTC `run_code` failures | `"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"tool/result` (isError=true) | official kind (`exception`/`timeout`/`abort`/…) / raw message |
| Nest"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ed tool calls inside a code program (`tools.*` throwing) | `tool/code-dispatch` (isError=true) | `to"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ol` / `[bash] exit code: 1` |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> **Trigger condition**: a failure is recorded only when the tool result is marked `isError: true`. "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"**A non-zero shell exit code does NOT trigger recording** (e.g. `exit 1` is presented as plain text "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"`[exit code: 1]`, not an error) — only genuinely thrown tool calls (read on a missing file, grep fai"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"lure, run_code crash, …) enter the log."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The observation point is the **session log** (`session/event`) — the exact same hook the official te"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"lemetry plugin uses. Pure observer: no service injection, no runtime wrapping, can never affect exec"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"y plugin uses. Pure observer: no service injection, no runtime wrapping, can never affect execution."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Session failures (captured automatically) | Skill auto-log section |
|:---:|:---:|"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"*Legend — left: tool failures in a session are captured automatically; right: the causes accumulate "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"in the skill's auto-log section (deduplicated, counted, ranked by frequency).*"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Section preview"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Restart `dsh --profile web`. Zero configuration, works out of the box. Same for headless: `dsh plugi"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"n --profile headless add …`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Config (patch entry `config:`, all optional)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Always-on instructions (push)**: injects code-time rules (write scripts to disk before running /"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" no Shell/Python in template strings / derive paths via import.meta.url / confirm edit old_string ag"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ainst read content) as an English system-prompt section on every agent step (~42 tokens/step, `injec"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"tInstructions: false` to disable) — prevents execution-time mistakes without AGENTS.md or skill load"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ing;
- Listens to `session/event`, consuming three event kinds: `tool/call` (builds a callId→{tool n"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"ame, args} map), `tool/result` (parses the real rc.6 shape: `message.content[].type === 'tool-result"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"'` block's `isError`/`toolCallId`; legacy shape still supported), `tool/code-dispatch` (recorded onl"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"y when isError). A one-time visible warning fires on unexpected shapes.
- **Normalized dedup**: path"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"s (quoted / drive-letter / absolute → `<path>`) and long numbers (→ `<n>`) are normalized before the"},{"id":"p21s10","text":" SHA1 key — the same EPERM on `/Users/a/x` and `/Users/b/y` merges into one entry; `data.error.code`"},{"id":"p21s11","text":" (e.g. `SEARCH_FAILED`) joins the key when present.
- **Redaction & sanitization**: defaults cover `"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"sk-…` keys, `Bearer`/`Basic` auth, `-u user:pass` and inline URL credentials, `api_key/token/secret/"},{"id":"p21s13","text":"password=` assignments, credential file paths, and private IPs; extend via `config.redact`. Control "},{"id":"p21s14","text":"chars stripped, markdown pipes/backticks escaped, **instruction-injection defense** (system-reminder"},{"id":"p21s15","text":"-style tags and common imperative phrases stripped + angle-bracket entity escaping) and a section-le"},{"id":"p21s16","text":"vel data-boundary declaration (the log is data, never instructions).
- **Cross-process lock-merge**:"},{"id":"p21s17","text":" flush takes an exclusive lock (`wx`, stale >5s recycled) and re-reads + merges the on-disk state be"},{"id":"p21s18","text":"fore writing — web/headless concurrency no longer loses increments; failed writes keep dirty and ret"},{"id":"p21s19","text":"ry after 2s.
- **Trend & TTL**: per-day counters render a "last 7 days" trend line; entries with no "},{"id":"p21s20","text":"new occurrence for `ttlDays` are archived.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Three-tier prevention"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The plugin splits failure prevention into three tiers:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Why timeouts are now first-class rules"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Across the local session logs, **19 timeout-class failures** were observed: 7 `glob`, 5 `grep`, and "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"7 `run_code`. Most were not model-capability issues but scope problems:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- over-wide searches: whole-drive `glob` on `C:\` / `D:\`, or `grep` over huge paths such as `node_m"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"odules` and DSH install directories;
- long work stuffed into `run_code`: installs, recursive scans,"},{"id":"p27s3","text":" or waiting for user answers inside the program."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"These failures are expensive: one failed round-trip typically costs 10–60 seconds and one whole-driv"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"e search can cost 30–170 seconds. For completion speed, timeout is more expensive than tokens, so th"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"e timeout patterns are promoted to static prevention rules."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Only failures that reach the session log**: catastrophic process death during tool execution is "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"out of scope.
- **Corrupt state is backed up**: an unparseable `.failures.json` is renamed to `.fail"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ures.json.bak-<timestamp>` before reset.
- **Non-zero exit codes are not recorded**: see the trigger"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" conditions (DSH semantics, not a plugin bug).
- **Dedup is heuristic**: keyed on the normalized fir"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"st 1-3 lines of text; the same root cause with different wording may split, and different causes wit"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"h identical wording may merge — acceptable, but be aware.
- **Display keeps the original text**: pat"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"h/username normalization affects the dedup key only; messages display the original (except redaction"},{"id":"p30s8","text":" rules). For stricter privacy, configure `config.redact` per workspace."}],"truncated":true}
